latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of aport-handoff skill

- Enables packaging and delivering completed work for handoff with verifiable APort decisions.
- Builds a handoff document containing proof-backed records of completed tasks, referencing signed APort decisions.
- Clearly surfaces incomplete or blocked tasks with required attention.
- Provides guidance for document delivery and verification best practices.
- Ensures recipients can independently verify every work claim via APort.
